title: Microsoft starts removing WMIC tool used by cybercriminals
summary: Microsoft announced that it removed the Windows Management Instrumentation Command-line (WMIC) tool from Windows 11 24H2 and 25H2, as well as from Windows 11 beta builds released this week. Once attackers are using valid credentials, prevention drops sharply.
